notes.title: Game Tips | Practical Tips for Battle, Build and Jump etc.
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630234/89a1dc5370c2a7349c7bc50f4987da7c3e3accab.png"][/img][/p][p]To know some tips will help you get started with the game more easily and quickly!ːsteamhappyː[/p][p][/p][h3]Battle Tips:[/h3][olist][*][p]This game focuses on sparring and suppression. When the enemy attacks, launch your attack will cause suppression and slow down the enemy's move.[/p][/*][*][p]If the suppression exceeds a certain number of times, the enemy will be OVERTAKEN which interrupt its attack and cause high damage;[/p][/*][*][p]Blocking can block most of the damage, but the enemy's heavy attack (golden light) cannot be blocked;[/p][/*][*][p]To be continued...[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Adding Attributes Tips:[/h3][olist][*][p]It is relatively fragile in the early stage, and the attributes can be allocated more to agility (add armor) and vitality (add life);[/p][/*][*][p]For the Talents, it is recommended to prioritize Hunyuan , learn the whirlwind style to rebound the projectile, and learn the Xingyi style to play multiple attacks, which is easier to OVERTAKE the enemy's attack;[/p][/*][*][p]Remember to equip the item you picked up in time![/p][/*][*][p]To be continued...[/p][/*][/olist][h3]Jumping tips:[/h3][olist][*][p]Some places in the game require jumping skills to reach. Press the spacebar (controller A) to jump up, roll once, double jump, and then roll again to jump farther.[/p][p][/p][/*][/olist][p]If you encounter any difficulties or bugs, feel free to leave a message and I will check and supplement them one by one.ːsteamthumbsupː[/p]

notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45630234/0545d985b52bdd5b577c848f5f4f0c7c297ed220.png"][/img][/p][p]Dear Monkey Bros,[/p][p]Long time no see![/p][p][/p][p]My new game [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3686170/Monkey_King_Simulator_Special_Edition/?snr=1_2108_9__2107"]Monkey King Simulator Special Edition[/url] is now on Sale![/p][p][/p][p]Based on my first UE4 game, [/p][p]this new game has been fully rebuilt and upgraded with Unreal Engine 5.[/p][p]The Action, Gameplay and End-game content have been greatly improved![/p][p]And fully support controller now.[/p][p][/p][p]If you like souls-like game and loot game such as Diablo, [/p][p]DON'T miss this game![/p][p]Enjoy the exciting interaction and role-development experience in [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3686170/Monkey_King_Simulator_Special_Edition/?snr=1_2108_9__2107"]Monkey King Simulator Special Edition[/url].[/p][p][/p][p]Good Luck & Have Fun![/p]
